# Delta broadens summer schedule with new and expanded weekend routes


New seasonal service and added frequencies will give customers more opportunities to reach mountain towns, coastal communities and other popular warm-weather destinations.


Staff Writer


Nov 6, 2026 9:45am


Delta is expanding its summer 2027 schedule with seasonal service and additional weekend frequencies to popular leisure destinations across the U.S., Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.


“We’re continuing to tailor Delta’s schedule around where our customers want to travel,” said Amy Martin, Vice President - Network Planning. “By adding weekend flights to some of the most sought-after leisure destinations across the U.S., Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean, we’re giving customers more flexibility and more ways to make the most of their summer.”


### **Seasonal weekend service**


*Bozeman, Montanta*


Delta will offer seasonal weekend service connecting customers to popular leisure destinations across the U.S. and Canada. The latest additions include:


Atlanta (ATL) to Bangor, Maine (BGR) May 29 - Oct. 24


Atlanta (ATL) to Traverse City, Michigan (TVC) May 29 - Sept. 6


Atlanta (ATL) to Rapid City, South Dakota (RAP) May 29 - Sept. 4


Detroit (DTW) to Bangor, Maine (BGR) June 12 - Oct. 23


Detroit (DTW) to Bozeman, Montana (BZN) June 12 - Sept. 4


Detroit (DTW) to Pensacola, Florida (PNS) June 12 - Sept. 4


Detroit (DTW) to Destin-Fort Walton Beach, Florida (VPS) June 12 - Sept. 4


Los Angeles (LAX) to Bozeman, Montana (BZN) June 12 - Sept. 4


Los Angeles (LAX) to Jackson Hole, Wyoming (JAC) June 12 - Sept. 4


Austin (AUS) to Kalispell, Montana (FCA) June 12 - Sept. 4


Austin (AUS) to Bozeman, Montana (BZN) June 12 - Sept. 4


Delta’s expanded summer schedule also includes previously loaded weekend flights from Boston (BOS) and New York-LaGuardia (LGA).


**From Boston (BOS):**


Myrtle Beach, South Carolina (MYR)


Norfolk, Virginia (ORF)


Asheville, North Carolina (AVL)


Halifax, Nova Scotia (YHZ)


Charleston, South Carolina (CHS)


Bozeman, Montana (BZN)


Savannah, Georgia (SAV)


Wilmington, North Carolina (ILM)


**From New York-LaGuardia (LGA):**


Panama City, Florida (ECP)


Destin-Fort Walton Beach, Florida (VPS)


### **More flights to popular summer destinations**


Delta is also adding an additional weekend frequency on several existing routes, creating more seats and schedule options for summer travelers:


Atlanta (ATL) to Burlington, Vermont (BTV) May 29 - Sept. 4


Detroit (DTW) to Myrtle Beach, South Carolina (MYR) June 12 - Sept. 4


Minneapolis-St. Paul (MSP) to Kalispell, Montana (FCA) June 12 - Sept. 4


Cincinnati (CVG) to Orlando, Florida (MCO) April 17 - Sept. 4


Cincinnati (CVG) to Fort Myers, Florida (RSW) April 17 - Sept. 4


### **More weekend options to Latin America and the Caribbean**


Delta is also expanding weekend flying to Latin America and the Caribbean for spring and summer 2027, with additional Saturday frequencies and extended seasonal service in 10 markets.


*Cayman Islands*


**From Atlanta (ATL), customers will have expanded weekend service to:**


Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands (GCM)


Guadalajara, Mexico (GDL)


Providenciales, Turks and Caicos (PLS)


Panama City, Panama (PTY)


St. Lucia (UVF)


**Additional weekend flying will also operate between:**


Detroit (DTW) and Aruba (AUA)


Detroit (DTW) and Montego Bay, Jamaica (MBJ)


Detroit (DTW) and Nassau, Bahamas (NAS)


New York-JFK (JFK) and Aruba (AUA)


Los Angeles (LAX) and Los Cabos, Mexico (SJD)


The expanded schedule will extend select seasonal routes further into the spring and summer while adding more Saturday options during peak leisure travel periods. The new Saturday frequency between Atlanta (ATL) and St. Lucia (UVF) will also provide enhanced connectivity for customers traveling through Delta’s Atlanta hub.


*Flights are operated as a mix between Delta and Delta Connection.*
